ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

3. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

4. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

5. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.

6. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

8. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

9. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

10. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

13. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.

14. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

15. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

16. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthing and Excess Current Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Inspection and Testing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
